evaluation_methodology: Silver-standard: both train and test labels come from the same gazetteer/regex auto-annotation, not independent human annotation. Scores measure whether the neural model reproduces the rule-based labeller on unseen PDFs (PDF-level 80/20 split, curated seeds train-only), not ground-truth extraction quality. v2.2 activates the previously-unused DAMAGE keyword list (descriptive damage phrases, not just LKR money regex), expands COUNT unit nouns from ~8 to ~30, and raises the PDF sample from 90 to 600 so DAMAGE/COUNT instances survive into the held-out test split.

previous_version.note: DAMAGE F1 was 0.0 (keyword list defined but never used in annotation); COUNT had only 2 test instances.
